Alex: Quick sync — we need to get listing artifacts and entitlement mapping ready for AWS/GCP/Azure pilot next month. Is legal signoff ready?
Maria: I can take AWS listing + hero assets. Do we have AMI IDs and lead image? cc @Sam for pricing bundles.
Sam: I'll own packaging + trial SKU mapping. Need SKU naming convention doc: https://drive.re/redwood/sku-guidelines (placeholder). Will ensure metering tags included.
Dan: GCP here. Need test account for pub portal. @Priya can you share a service account with pub access?
Priya: Azure handoff for private offers and marketplace plans. Need EULA clause for BYOS/KMS — @Ravi?
Ravi: Legal: we need a short data residency clause (region-level) + KMS responsibilities. I'll draft an EULA addendum by Tue and post review comments.
Maria: Assets checklist (quick): logo SVG/PNG, screenshots 1200x628 + 800x600, short/long descriptions, screenshots captions, AMI IDs (aws), image family (gcp), plan SKU json (azure), compliance certs.
Alex: Could we standardize the entitlement JSON? Proposed minimal schema:
```
{
  "sku": "redwood:pilot:standard",
  "trial_days": 14,
  "entitlements": ["inference_units","embeddings_units"],
  "regions": ["us-west-2","europe-west1"]
}
```
Sam: I'll author the SKU generator and a small script to validate entitlements.json. Also adding telemetry hooks to Console to capture token/unit usage for billing reconciliation.
MarketplaceBot: Reminder: vendor portal submission window opens in 72 hours for account 12345. Please ensure metadata and tech contact are filled.
Dan: Proposed timeline: assets due Fri EOD, legal signoff Mon, submit to vendor portal Tue, publish staging Wed, pilot go-live next Thu. Any blockers?
Priya: Azure ok with that timeline but need finance to confirm CSP billing mapping. I'll loop in @Sam-Finance.
Alex: Let's take 30m Tuesday 09:00 PT to run through checklist and do a dry run of the portal submission. I'll send invite. :calendar:
Maria: :thumbsup:
Ravi: Draft EULA addendum posted — https://drive.re/redwood/eula-addendum. Please comment by EOD Monday.
